body.name: tied-risk finite-support witness
body.construction: Fix \(\lambda\in(0,1)\), \(t\in(0,1]\), and \(\sigma_0^2,\sigma_1^2>0\).  Along rows with \(\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}\to\lambda\), take no covariates, \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) in the trial, independent trial potential outcomes equal to \(\pm\sigma_a\) with probability one half, \(L((x,y);\theta)=(y-\theta)^2/2\), and an independent uniform tie breaker.  On rows with \(t_n^{\dagger}<t/2\), set the external outcome to zero.  On rows with \(t_n^{\dagger}\geq t/2\), set the external outcome to \(Y=a_n^{\dagger}/\sqrt n\), with \(a_n^{\dagger}\) given by its corrected displayed formula.  Every external score is equal, so \(U_n(Z)=V\) and prefix \(k_n^{\dagger}\) is exactly \(V\leq t_n^{\dagger}\).  On the latter rows the amplitude equates the within-stratum variance gain \(D_n\) with squared local bias \(B_n^2(a_n^{\dagger})^2\) plus within-stratum shift variance \(K_n^{\dagger}(a_n^{\dagger})^2/n\).
